workspaces.description: Chromium is a free and open-source browser, primarily developed and maintained by Google.
PokeMMO is a free-to-play MMORPG based on the Pokemon games. This workspace allows you to play PokeMMO directly in your browser. IMPORTANT: Users must provide their own legitimate ROM sources.
workspaces.startup_script:
#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if ROM exists
check_rom() {
    local filename=$1
    if [ -f "/pokemmo/roms/$filename" ]; then
        echo "ROM already exists: $filename"
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

# Function to download ROM
download_rom() {
    local url=$1
    local filename=$2
    local destination=$3
    
    if [ -f "$destination/$filename" ]; then
        echo "ROM already exists: $filename"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Downloading $filename..."
    mkdir -p $destination
    wget -q --show-progress -O "$destination/$filename" "$url"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Successfully downloaded: $filename"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Failed to download: $filename"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Create ROM directory
mkdir -p /pokemmo/roms

# Check and download required ROM (Black/White)
if ! check_rom "pokemon_black.nds" && ! check_rom "pokemon_white.nds"; then
    echo "Required ROM not found, attempting download..."
    if ! download_rom "${ROM_CONFIG_POKEMON_BLACK_URL}" "pokemon_black.nds" "/pokemmo/roms"; then
        echo "ERROR: Failed to download required ROM (Pokemon Black)"
        echo "Please ensure the download URL is correct and accessible"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Define optional ROMs and their URLs
declare -A optional_roms=(
    ["pokemon_firered.gba"]="${ROM_CONFIG_POKEMON_FIRERED_URL}"
    ["pokemon_emerald.gba"]="${ROM_CONFIG_POKEMON_EMERALD_URL}"
    ["pokemon_platinum.nds"]="${ROM_CONFIG_POKEMON_PLATINUM_URL}"
    ["pokemon_heartgold.nds"]="${ROM_CONFIG_POKEMON_HEARTGOLD_URL}"
)

# Check and download optional ROMs
echo "\nChecking optional ROMs..."
for rom in "${!optional_roms[@]}"; do
    if ! check_rom "$rom"; then
        echo "Optional ROM not found: $rom"
        if download_rom "${optional_roms[$rom]}" "$rom" "/pokemmo/roms"; then
            echo "Successfully downloaded optional ROM: $rom"
        else
            echo "Failed to download optional ROM: $rom - continuing anyway"
        fi
    fi
done

# Final ROM verification
echo "\nVerifying available ROMs:"
found_required=false
echo "Required ROMs:"
if [ -f "/pokemmo/roms/pokemon_black.nds" ]; then
    echo "✓ Pokemon Black"
    found_required=true
fi
if [ -f "/pokemmo/roms/pokemon_white.nds" ]; then
    echo "✓ Pokemon White"
    found_required=true
fi

if ! $found_required; then
    echo "✗ No required ROM found (Black/White)"
    exit 1
fi

echo "\nOptional ROMs:"
for rom in "${!optional_roms[@]}"; do
    if [ -f "/pokemmo/roms/$rom" ]; then
        echo "✓ $(basename "$rom" .gba | basename .nds | sed 's/pokemon_/Pokemon /; s/_/ /g' | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++)sub(/./,toupper(substr($i,1,1)),$i)}FS="")')"
    else
        echo "✗ $(basename "$rom" .gba | basename .nds | sed 's/pokemon_/Pokemon /; s/_/ /g' | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++)sub(/./,toupper(substr($i,1,1)),$i)}FS="")')"
    fi
done

echo "\nROM verification complete. Starting PokeMMO..."
